crossRefs.note: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because…
Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.
which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace,’…
that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey,’ as it is…
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will…

translations.web: Now, Yahweh God, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm it forever, and do as you have spoken.
translations.bsb: And now, O LORD God, confirm forever the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house. Do as You have promised,
translations.kjv: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.
translations.asv: And now, O Jehovah God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, confirm thou it for ever, and do as thou hast spoken.
